Total number of questions — 20
49
Development of infrastructure and
connectivity
*141. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. MABEL REBELLO:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
development of infrastructure and
connectivity is the single most important
factor to remove regional disparities;
(b) whether Government has
formulated certain specific anti-poverty
programmes with focus on infrastructure
and connectivity especially with reference
to Orissa and Jharkhand States; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Incident of roof-fall in coal mines
†*142. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an incident
of roof-fall in Moari mine of Chhindwara
district in Kanhan area had taken place in
recent days;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the details of the losses due to this
roof-fall and the cost thereof;
(d) whether there is no warning system
or assessment of possibility of such
incidents and whether it could not be
prevented; and
(e) the official responsible for this
incident who was supposed to make efforts
to prevent this incident by prior assessment
of the same and the action taken against him?
Depletion of foreign exchange reserves
*143. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a large amount of the
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

50
country's foreign exchange reserves has
depleted in the last six months;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether the fast depletion of foreign
exchange reserves has serious implications
and depreciation on the value of rupee; and
(d) if so, the steps Government
proposes to take in this regard?
Permission for erection of surface
structures in coal-bearing areas
*144. SHRI R.C. SINGH: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is giving permission for surface structures
such as airports, buildings, complexes, etc.
in the coal bearing areas of the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
unauthorized people have also occupied
some of the coal belts in the country which
otherwise deprive the country from
extracting India's primary source of energy,
i.e. coal; and
(c) if so, the reasons behind giving
permission for such structures and what
rehabilitation steps Government is taking
or proposes to take to rehabilitate those
people who are under occupation of such
land which contains coal reserves?
Extradition treaty with Nepal
*145. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: W ill the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Nepal have
decided to modify the existing extradition
treaty that would allow the two countries
to hand over criminals of third country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the nexus between trans-
border criminals is increasing and in the
absence of an extradition treaty, criminals
are freely enjoying; and
(d) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
Relocation of human settlements in
Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary
*146. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether he has received a project
proposal from Kerala Government for
voluntary relocation of human settlements
in Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of tribal and non-tribal
families to be relocated;
(d) the total cost of the project; and
(e) the status of the clearance of the
project along with the details of the amount
sanctioned and released, so far?
Protection of migrant labourers
*147. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
OVERSEAS INDIAN AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that thousands of
migrant labourers in middle east countries
are not getting their wages and legal dues
and many of them are still inside jail on
false fabricated cases; and
(b) if so, the action taken by
Government of India till today to protect
the migrant labourers in middle east
countries?
